methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This article is devoted to the analysis of how ISO 50001 can solve existing problems in the field of energy and how it contributes to save energy resources.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Energy-management implementation and maturity framework without an identifiable EnPI/EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: the researched organizations are at different stages of energy efficiency management according to the developed multi-stage model of the energy efficiency management process and the adapted carbon reliable energy management matrix

stage1.notes: The paper assesses EnMS implementation stages and organisational effects; it does not identify or characterise an EnPI/EnB measurement model.
